ideas.idea: Show FAQ questions and answers as visible text on the home page, not only in JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro only injects the FAQ via a script, so visitors and text-only readers never see the answers.

ideas.idea: Add a table of mooring sizes and seasonal prices to /moorings
ideas.why: The description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the page body only says prices start at £40 a night.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness structured data with name, Falmouth address and phone
ideas.why: No such data exists and the contact details are in the contact page, so this is concrete and specific.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and og tags, and wrap content in <main>
ideas.why: Accurate (they are missing from Base.astro) but standard boilerplate with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Set site in astro config and use @astrojs/sitemap instead of a static sitemap
ideas.why: Reasonable, but the static three-page sitemap is fine and the canonical fix doesn't need it.

ideas.idea: Link 'Seasonal and visitor moorings' on the home page to /moorings
ideas.why: The home page text mentions moorings with no in-content link, so a contextual link adds a useful path.

ideas.idea: Add Falmouth and the harbour name to the /moorings title
ideas.why: The title 'Moorings and prices' doesn't say where or whose, while the home page title does.

ideas.idea: Change the default robots value to 'index, follow'
ideas.why: This is the known max-snippet:0 problem restated as a fix, and 'index, follow' is the default behaviour anyway.
